about: Launch prices in India (MRP at launch, rupees) and launch months. On startup the backend applies a new version once: models missing from the catalog are added, the listed variants get the max value MaxValueRule gives for their launch price and age, and variants named in "replaces" are removed (placeholders); nothing else is touched. Phones, tablets, watches, earbuds and Macs: launch coverage (Apple, Samsung, Digit, 91mobiles, Free Press Journal, Fonearena, SamMobile, Business Today). Laptops named by series have one max value: a typical launch price of the series (mid configuration) for a 2023 unit unless the name gives the generation.
